status.en: 115 armed incidents reported in the past seven days, 15% more than the week before, most of them in Islamabad, Kabul and Peshawar.
status.nb: 115 væpnede hendelser meldt de siste sju dagene, 15 prosent flere enn uken før, flest i Islamabad, Kabul og Peshawar.

summary.en: Russia sent a major business delegation to Kabul for talks with the Taliban, while Pakistan security forces reported the death of a major among four troops and the killing of 24 terrorists in operations in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa and Balochistan, according to ISPR. Police in Rajasthan arrested two suspects in a railway-track blast case and linked them to a Pakistani handler, and the Peshawar anti-terrorism court moved to declare Sohail Afridi a proclaimed offender in the Radio Pakistan attack. Pakistan and 16 other countries condemned an Israeli strike on a southern Gaza hospital, and Abdul Samad’s late strike sent Pakistan into the SAFF Championship final. The conflict accounted for 1,794 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.
summary.nb: Russland sendte en stor forretningsdelegasjon til Kabul for samtaler med Taliban, mens pakistanske sikkerhetsstyrker rapporterte døden til en major blant fire soldater og drapet på 24 terrorister i operasjoner i Khyber Pakhtunkhwa og Balochistan, ifølge ISPR. Politiet i Rajasthan arresterte to mistenkte i en sak om sprengning av jernbanespor og knyttet dem til en pakistansk håndterer, og den antiterrorretten i Peshawar gikk videre med å erklære Sohail Afridi som etterlyst i Radio Pakistan-angrepet. Pakistan og 16 andre land fordømte et israelsk angrep på et sykehus i sørlige Gaza, og Abdul Samads sene scoring sendte Pakistan inn i SAFF-mesterskapets finale. Konflikten medførte 1 794 dødsfall i kamp i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

background.title: Insurgency in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa
background.extract: Since 2004, an insurgency has been fought in the Pakistani province of Khyber Pakhtunkhwa by Islamist militant groups such as the Tehrik-i-Taliban Pakistan (TTP), Jundallah, Lashkar-e-Islam (LeI), the Tehreek-e-Nafaz-e-Shariat-e-Mohammadi (TNSM), Al-Qaeda, and their Central Asian allies such as the Islamic State – Khorasan Province (ISKP), Islamic Movement of Uzbekistan, East Turkistan Movement, Jamaat-ul-Ahrar, Ittihad-ul-Mujahideen Pakistan, and elements of organised crime. Before being transformed into an insurgency in 2017, the conflict was a war.
